description: ADO-PERSIST typed round trip: a client static read-only Recordset of SELECT * FROM T ORDER BY ID is saved as ADTG and as XML (both files kept); the original's Field metadata (Name, Type, DefinedSize, Precision, NumericScale, Attributes) is read; each file is reopened connectionless with adCmdFile (State, RecordCount, ActiveConnection, the same metadata, then Value and ActualSize of every field of every row). Asks what schema, types, sizes and values each format restores.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
